ns2:section.sectionText: Special Topics: Artist Books: Creating conceptually driven works in various constructs of the book form. Students will explore ways of thinking through a variety of historical and contemporary methods and traditions. This course encourages connections between content and form while developing heightened sensitivity to materials, processes and presentation. Digital and traditional routes are used to explore both the physical and the conceptual implications of the ways things are made. Projects that intersect with work developed in other studio and design areas will be encouraged. Graduate section.
